description: World Integrated Trade Solution UN COMTRADE is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Policies and plans", published or maintained by World Bank Group (World Bank Group). Access UN COMTRADE including exports, re-exports and re-imports in Harmonized System (HS) and Standard Industrial Trade Classification (SITC). Convert into derived nomenclatures like ISIC, SIC, MTN, NACE, GTAP, BEC and more. Aggregate Trade Indicator to analyze a country's export competitiveness. Perform GVC analysis for country, region, intra-region and product of interest. Coverage: East Asia and the Pacific. It has 3 files. The portal files it under Policies and plans. The portal gives 2021 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
